content:
Earlier this year, Twelve South launched the new Valet accessory, which they described as a "wireless charging stand and personal tray for everyday items."

Now, Twelve South has expanded the Valet series with a smaller option that supports MagSafe and Qi2.2 wireless charging, with charging speeds of up to 25W.

The first-generation Valet announced earlier this year measured 7.5 inches, offering enough room to hold a phone, keys, wallet, glasses, and other items. However, the new Valet is much smaller, at just 4.25 inches.

Here is Twelve South's description of the Valet's premium design:

Valet is first and foremost a beautiful home accessory, and only second a precision wireless charger. It blends warm materials with modern, precise craftsmanship to create a calmer, more mindful form factor that fits anywhere in the home—from the entryway table, to the kitchen, to the bedside table. The soft square charging pad mirrors the architectural lines of the leather tray, while a weighted zinc alloy base keeps everything stable and tidy.

In terms of features, the smaller Valet has enough power to charge your iPhone, with an additional built-in USB-C port for conveniently charging other accessories:

  • Qi2.2 wireless charging up to 25W
  • Premium Nappa leather tray
  • Four configurable placement orientations
  • Replaceable, detachable leather rim
  • Weighted zinc alloy base with hidden cable management
  • Additional USB-C port supports up to 10W wired charging
  • Includes 45W power supply and 1.5m USB-C cable

The 4.25-inch Twelve South Valet is available for pre-order starting today at $129.99, offered in three color combinations. The price is not cheap, but it's a great spot to set down your phone to charge while holding your glasses, wallet, or keys.
